Our approach

You know what it feels like to love a child, now you have the power to give that gift to someone else. As a surrogate you carry a baby created through IVF, meaning you share no biological connection to the baby.

You won't experience this level of care and advocacy elsewhere. Why? Because our entire team has experienced a surrogacy journey themselves.

– Surrogate Sarah

Give the gift of life and find new meaning in yours.

Generous compensation

01

Family Makers Surrogates make an average of $95,000 in base compensation and other benefits.

Holistic benefits

02

Curated benefits include a monthly allowance, lost wages, childcare, a wellness package, mental health support, monthly support groups, maternity clothing, and postpartum support.

Fully customizable

03

Our compensation package is fully customizable. Your compensation is unique, just like your journey. You always have a choice.
